title: Fibber McGee and Molly
paragraphs: A landmark radio comedy following Fibber and Molly McGee in the fictional town of Wistful Vista, surrounded by recurring neighbors, running gags, and Fibber's endless schemes.

Jim and Marian Jordan’s long-running NBC comedy centered on 79 Wistful Vista. The frozen GRH snapshot begins after the documented April 1935 premiere and includes a 1981 AFRTS Christmas special that is not treated as part of the original 1935-1959 run.

GRH documents the program through Weekly half-hour era (April 16, 1935 to June 30, 1953) on [[org|org.f2f0561f0ce2ddc5|NBC Radio Network]], 15-minute weekday strip era (October 5, 1953 to March 23, 1956) on [[org|org.f2f0561f0ce2ddc5|NBC Radio Network]], and Monitor sketch era (June 1, 1957 to September 6, 1959) on [[org|org.f2f0561f0ce2ddc5|NBC Radio Network]].

Among the most extensively documented contributors in the GRH holdings are [[person|jim-jordan|Jim Jordan]] (performer on 496 recordings), [[person|marian-jordan|Marian Jordan]] (performer on 490 recordings), Phil Leslie (writer on 395 recordings), [[person|bill-thompson|Bill Thompson]] (performer on 363 recordings), Arthur Q. Bryan (performer on 300 recordings), Max Hutto (director on 276 recordings and performer on 2 recordings), and Harlow Wilcox (performer on 226 recordings and announcer on 27 recordings).
The program is also connected in the archive to [[org|org.f2f0561f0ce2ddc5|NBC Radio Network]] (broadcast on network) and [[org|org.a1cc4e5534fec5a3|WMAQ]] (aircheck from station).
